name: Penumbral Aegis (Ex)
body:
Prerequisite: Nightblade 12

Benefit: The nightblade can use shadowstuff to redirect attacks that would normally bypass her defenses. The nightblade adds her Charisma modifier (minimum +0) as a bonus to her touch AC. This cannot make her touch AC exceed her normal AC.
